annotations.ce_understood_harm: Five people down there could be crushed if that train reaches them
annotations.ae_welfare_concern: that's not something I can just gloss over
annotations.pd_personal_consequence_anxiety: I'd hate to be the one who froze
annotations.pda_self_consequence_regret: have to explain to my supervisor why I hesitated

annotations.ce_understood_harm: Those five men on the track would be seriously hurt or worse
annotations.sys_consequence_reasoning: rather deal with paperwork afterward than carry the regret
annotations.pda_harm_regret: carry the regret of having stood here doing nothing while people got hurt

annotations.ce_understood_harm: I keep picturing those workers getting hit
annotations.ae_welfare_concern: that image is exactly why I can't just shrug it off
annotations.pd_harm_distress: I keep picturing those workers getting hit
annotations.pd_personal_consequence_anxiety: than live with people thinking I didn't try to prevent harm

annotations.ce_understood_harm: The five workers would be badly injured if the train reaches them
annotations.ae_welfare_concern: I recognize how serious that is
annotations.pda_self_consequence_regret: regret it deeply if my name got attached to indecision

annotations.ce_understood_harm: If that train keeps going, those five people get hurt
annotations.pd_personal_consequence_anxiety: What I don't want is people questioning my judgment later

annotations.ae_welfare_concern: ignoring that isn't something I'm willing to do
annotations.pda_responsibility: If something went wrong with my choice, I'd rather own it directly

annotations.ce_understood_harm: those five men could be killed if this train isn't stopped
annotations.pda_harm_regret: Missing this chance to act and living with that outcome would bother me

annotations.ce_understood_harm: Five workers standing on that track could be crushed
annotations.ae_welfare_concern: I can't pretend that possibility isn't in front of me
annotations.pda_harm_regret: carry the weight of not having tried

annotations.ce_understood_harm: Those five people down the line would suffer real harm
annotations.pda_harm_regret: I'd genuinely regret staying passive here

annotations.ce_understood_harm: those five workers get seriously hurt
annotations.pda_harm_regret: looking back and knowing I hesitated when acting was simple
